newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania's Constantinescu to visit Prague.
newsitem.headline: Romania's Constantinescu to visit Prague.

text.p: Romania's reformist president Emil Constantinescu will start a two-day visit to Prague on Monday in a bid get Czech leaders' support for his country's bid to join NATO among first-wave entrants.

Romania is lobbying for admission, along with Poland, the Czech Republic and Hungary, to the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation when it announces its first eastward expansion at a Madrid summit in July.
Constantinescu's centrists, who ousted ex-communists in elections last year, have pledged tough reforms to bridge the gap separating their country from more advanced East Europeans.

Constantinescu will meet Czech President Vaclav Havel, Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus and Czech business leaders, to woo investors to the planned selloff of state industries, including public utilities and banks, presidential sources said.
